## Outcome

State the user-visible or canonical runtime behavior.

## Scope and dependencies

Link source requirement IDs, sprint, deadline and prerequisite issues. Identify customer configuration versus shared capability.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Canonical contract, permissions and scope enforced
- [ ] Applicable successful, denied, failure and retry cases exercised
- [ ] Connected UI/API/MCP behavior documented where supported
- [ ] Exact build/configuration and evidence linked

## Evidence boundary

Distinguish implemented, locally verified, customer accepted and deployed. List unresolved inputs and the next action.
